item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta.1
item.description:
### Added
- Automatic updates via Sparkle (`Glass › Check for Updates…`), with notarized builds published to the public release feed. - Tab Overview grid for browsing, previewing, and switching between all tabs in a window. - Tab sidebar with folder grouping, numbered tab badges, swipe-to-close, and an inspector panel, plus a compact numbered tab strip in the toolbar when the sidebar is collapsed. - Light mode appearance, Material Map for tuning glass opacity and tint, adaptive text contrast, and a theme-tinted Dock icon. - Environment settings tab for managing shell environment variables and macOS Keychain-backed secrets, with live `Shell › Reload Variables` for open tabs and `Glass env` sharing across shells. - Built-in `Glass.help` documentation book with contextual help buttons in Settings and Environment sheets. - Shell integration (`OSC 133`) with prompt jumping, semantic marks, command completion notifications, and background bell alerts. - Secure Keyboard Entry (`Glass › Secure Keyboard Entry`), Finder Services (`New Glass Window at Folder` and `New Glass Tab at Folder`), file drag-and-drop insertion, and `⌘`-click titlebar path menu.
### Improved
- Redesigned native AppKit Settings window with a unified toolbar, live appearance preview, custom stepped number fields, and Glass dropdown menus. - Smoother sidebar, inspector, and Tab Overview spring animations, with stronger scroll-edge fade and frosted titlebar wells on light surfaces. - Bundled true italic and bold font faces across weights, plus crisp unsmoothed font rendering scoped to Glass windows while keeping menus and system dialogs native. - Restores windows to their previous display, size, and full-screen state, and strengthens chrome contrast under macOS Increase Contrast. - Live match feedback in the Find bar and full VoiceOver accessibility support across terminal content and tab chrome.
### Fixed
- Terminal programs now prompt before reading the clipboard, and unusual link schemes ask for confirmation before opening. - Bracketed-paste wrapping, CRLF multiline paste detection, and Unicode-safe `Paste Escaped Text` escaping. - Blank tab recovery after switching tabs, first-row height stability when zooming font size, and saving window size without capturing full-screen transitions. - Settings Appearance updates when switching macOS Light/Dark mode, and flushing uncommitted Settings edits on quit.
